body:
I have been taking large doses of DXM every day for 2 and a half years. Although it is not addictive physically addictive I have found it hard to go a day without using it. I have done all methods tussin, coriciden, robo soft gels, mucinex, agent lemon extraction process, and pure DXM. I do not recommend anyone try this drug it is as hard core as any I have ever done. I have tried it all, and this is as bad as it gets.
[Reported Dose: '1000 mg']
